name: expense
description: Temporal's expense sample as a certified machine: create the expense, wait for a person's approval within a window, pay once.

createExpense.why: register the expense with the expense server (the sample's activity, unchanged)

request_approval.why: money leaves next: a person decides

payment.why: pay the approved expense (the sample's activity, unchanged)

expenseId.description: the expense's business id; a second start for the same id attaches to the first run

unstoppable.paying: the payment is in flight: stopping would not unpay it; the run ends when the payment answers
